fields.statement: Verifier at 279833cc (attempt 5): go test -trimpath -run RoundRobin -v ./internal/daemon passes TestRoundRobinAcrossProjects (maxRuns 3 over A(3)/B(2)/C(1) picks A1,B1,C1), TestRoundRobinPerProjectMax (A max 1, maxRuns 4 picks A1,B1,C1,B2: A one slot, rest to B and C) and the new TestRoundRobinRotatesAcrossPolls (one slot per poll goes A,B,C,A,B). Read the diff: runDaemon keeps lastTurn across polls and passes it to daemon.RoundRobin, which starts after that project, so turns no longer restart at the home project (quality f2). Also passed: go test ./internal/daemon, go vet ./internal/api ./internal/daemon, TestScripts/daemon* (incl. daemon-round-robin) and go test ./internal/api -run Daemon.
